pages.title: Cute Santa Claus Waves with His Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: A mittened Santa Claus waves in this printable coloring page, holding a tied sack beside his buckled belt and wearing a hat with a fluffy pom-pom.

pages.title: Baby Reindeer Wears a Christmas Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a baby reindeer sitting with its hooves together, a large ribbon bow at its neck, and spots on its haunches.

pages.title: Cute Snowman Wears a Striped Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: A snowman raises its twig arms in this printable coloring page, with a striped scarf around its neck, a tall top hat, and three round buttons.

pages.title: Kawaii Christmas Tree with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Round ornaments hang below the smiling face of a kawaii Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with sweeping garlands leading up to a large star.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Elf Checks a Toy List Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a Christmas elf holds a pencil against a toy checklist with a teddy bear, a train, and a striped ball.

pages.title: Cute Gingerbread Man Waves One Arm Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man waves from this printable coloring page, with two round candy buttons and wavy lines of icing across his forehead, wrists, and ankles.

pages.title: Christmas Penguin in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A little penguin stretches out both flippers in this printable coloring page, with a floppy Santa hat above its pointed beak and a broad oval belly.

pages.title: Christmas Kitten Peeks Out of a Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kitten in a Santa hat peeking over a stocking cuff, with a ribbon bow and holly leaves decorating the front.

pages.title: Christmas Puppy Pops Out of a Gift Box Coloring Page
pages.description: A floppy-eared puppy rests both paws on the rim of an open gift box in this printable coloring page, wearing a bow beneath its chin.

pages.title: Rudolph Pulls Santa's Christmas Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Rudolph pulls Santa’s sleigh by long reins while Santa waves beside a tied sack above the sleigh’s curled wooden runners.

pages.title: Christmas Polar Bear Hugs a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated polar bear hugs a striped candy cane in this printable coloring page, with a scarf wrapped around its neck and paw pads facing forward.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Gnome Carries a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A bearded Christmas gnome carries a small fir tree in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall knitted hat with bands of diamonds and snowflakes.

pages.title: Kawaii Christmas Present with a Big Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: A wide ribbon curls over the lid of a smiling Christmas present in this printable coloring page, with long bow tails and bands down the sides.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Stocking Full of Toys Coloring Page
pages.description: A teddy bear peeks over a stocking cuff beside a drum and a candy cane in this printable coloring page, above a bow and wavy stripes.

pages.title: Kawaii Candy Cane with a Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: A candy cane smiles just beneath its striped hook in this printable coloring page, with a large ribbon bow tied around the lower half of the stick.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Ornament with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Stars and little trees frame the smiling face of a round ornament in this printable coloring page, beneath a scalloped cap and a loop for hanging.

pages.title: Kawaii Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, three marshmallows float in a smiling mug of hot chocolate, with steam above the rim and a striped scarf around the cup.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Cookies on a Plate Coloring Page
pages.description: A star, a tree, a bell, and a mitten share a round plate in this printable coloring page, with snowflake icing on two of the cookies.

pages.title: Kawaii Gingerbread House with a Cookie Chimney Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread house fills this printable coloring page, with a dotted chimney, a heart above the door, and rounded sweets lining the icing roof.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Snow Globe with a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: Inside the snow globe on this printable coloring page, a scarfed snowman lifts its twig arms between two snowflakes above a base tied with a bow.

pages.title: Santa Claus Peeks Out of a Chimney Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus peeks over a snowy chimney rim in this printable coloring page, resting both mittens on top above rows of bricks and overlapping roof tiles.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Ties a Bow on a Present Coloring Page
pages.description: A kneeling elf pulls a ribbon into a bow on this printable coloring page, with a square gift box and a loose roll of wrapping paper.

pages.title: Gingerbread Girl Wears an Icing Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: The gingerbread girl in this printable coloring page wears a large icing bow, with scalloped trim across her dress and wavy stripes on her cookie feet.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Tree with Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree rises above three wrapped presents in this printable coloring page, with bows and round ornaments along its branches beneath a five-pointed star.

pages.title: Cute Snowman Wears Fluffy Earmuffs Coloring Page
pages.description: Round earmuffs frame a snowman's carrot nose and smile in this printable coloring page, with raised twig arms and a scarf tucked under its chin.

pages.title: Baby Reindeer Rings a Christmas Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: A scarf wraps around the baby reindeer's neck in this printable coloring page, where it raises a bow-tied Christmas bell beneath its branching antlers.

pages.title: Two Penguins Ride a Christmas Sled Coloring Page
pages.description: Two penguins share a wooden sled in this printable coloring page, wearing different pom-pom hats as they sit behind the curved front runners.

pages.title: Christmas Teddy Bear Hugs a Present Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a teddy bear with stitched seams wears a floppy Santa hat and hugs a Christmas present with a big bow.

pages.title: Christmas Bunny Hangs an Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny in a fringed scarf reaches up to hang a round ornament on a Christmas tree with a ribbon-tied pot in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Fox Reaches for a Snowflake Coloring Page

pages.title: Christmas Owl Wears a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A floppy Santa hat tops the owl in this printable coloring page, where it perches on an evergreen sprig with layered feathers and round berries.

pages.title: Christmas Squirrel Carries a Tiny Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: A little squirrel holds a ribbon-wrapped Christmas gift in this printable coloring page, with a bushy tail sweeping up behind its striped winter scarf.

pages.title: Christmas Mouse Hangs a Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: Standing on a wooden stool, a mouse hangs a stocking in this printable coloring page, with a holly sprig below the stocking's fluffy cuff.

pages.title: Christmas Capybara in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara sits with its paws close together on this printable coloring page, wearing a floppy Santa hat above its rounded ears and broad muzzle.

pages.title: Christmas Unicorn Wears a Jingle Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: The unicorn in this printable coloring page wears a jingle bell beneath a bow, with a spiral horn above its flowing mane.

pages.title: Puppy Tangled in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: A string of Christmas lights loops around a puppy in this printable coloring page, with large bulbs beside its paws and a bell at its collar.

pages.title: Kitten Naps Under a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A striped kitten curls up beside a wrapped gift on this printable coloring page, beneath a Christmas tree with round baubles and a star.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Bells with Holly Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling bells hang below a big ribbon bow in this printable coloring page, with pointed holly leaves and a cluster of berries above them.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Wreath with a Bow Coloring Page

pages.title: Kawaii Christmas Lights with Smiling Faces Coloring Page
pages.description: Five smiling Christmas light bulbs dangle from a looping cord in this printable coloring page, each with a broad outline and curved eyelashes.

pages.title: Smiling Christmas Star in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Christmas star wears a Santa hat and a bow tie in this printable coloring page, with three smaller stars scattered around it.

pages.title: Cute Snowflake with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: A snowflake spreads six rounded branches around its smiling face on this printable coloring page, with closed eyes and two round cheek marks.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Mittens with Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: A cord connects two smiling Christmas mittens in this printable coloring page, and each mitten has a large heart above its striped cuff.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Sweater with a Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling reindeer in a scarf decorates the sweater in this printable coloring page, surrounded by snowflakes, zigzag bands, and a ribbed collar.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Cupcake with a Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling cupcake has frosting shaped like a Christmas tree on this printable coloring page, with a star topper, round ornaments, and a ridged wrapper.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Angel Hugs a Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas angel hugs a five-pointed star in this printable coloring page, with a holly sprig in her hair and rounded wings behind her.

pages.title: Cute Nutcracker Holds a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: An oversized striped candy cane stands beside a smiling nutcracker in this printable coloring page, where its tall hat bears a star above a curled mustache.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Train Carries Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: A bear rides in the engine cab of this printable coloring page, while the smiling Christmas train pulls a wagon piled high with wrapped gifts.

pages.title: Christmas Animals Decorate a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny and a squirrel hang round ornaments on this printable coloring page, with a wrapped present below their Christmas tree and a star on top.

pages.title: Cozy Christmas Fireplace with Stockings Coloring Page
pages.description: Three stockings hang from a holly-trimmed mantel on this printable coloring page, above a tall flame and two logs inside a brick fireplace.
